Improved Gouge.text: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 0.5 sec.

Remorseless Attacks.text: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 20% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

Malice.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.

Ruthlessness.text: Gives your finishing moves a 20% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

Murder.text: Increases all damage dealt by 2% against Humanoid and Giant targets.

Improved Slice and Dice.text: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

Relentless Strikes.text: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

Improved Expose Armor.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 5, and refunds 1 Combo Point when cast with 5 Combo Points.

Lethality.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 4%.

Vile Poisons.text: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 4% and gives your poisons an additional 8% chance to resist dispel effects.

Cold Blood.text: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

Improved Poisons.text: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 2%, and gives Poison applications a 10% chance to not consume a charge.

Mutilate.text: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 13 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

Improved Kidney Shot.text: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 5% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

Seal Fate.text: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 20% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Venom.text: Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point:  1 point : 9 seconds  2 points: 12 seconds  3 points: 15 seconds  4 points: 18 second

Improved Eviscerate.text: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 7%.

Improved Sinister Strike.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike ability by 3.

Puncturing Wounds.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 10% and your Mutilate by 5%, and gives Backstab a 15% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

Precision.text: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

Endurance.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 30%.

Riposte.text: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

Improved Sprint.text: Gives a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

Improved Kick.text: Gives your Kick ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

Flawless Execution.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 10.

Dual Wield Specialization.text: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5%.

Blade Flurry.text: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

Hack and Slash.text: Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.   Axe/Sword: Your successful  melee attacks have a 1% chance  to trigger an extra attack on the   target.   Dagger/Fist: Increases your  critical strike

Weapon Expertise.text: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 1%.

Aggression.text: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike, Backstab, and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.

Adrenaline Rush.text: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

Camouflage.text: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 3% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

Master of Deception.text: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 1 level higher.

Opportunity.text: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 5%.

Setup.text: Gives you a 33% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging an attack or fully resisting a spell.

Elusiveness.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 45 sec.

Dirty Tricks.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 25%.

Improved Ambush.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 15%.

Initiative.text: Gives you a 33% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

Ghostly Strike.text: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

Improved Distract.text: Increases the radius of your Distract ability by 3 yds, and further reduces the Stealth detection of distracted enemies as though they were an additional 1 level lower.

Heightened Senses.text: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 1 level higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 2%.

Premeditation.text: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

Serrated Blades.text: Causes your attacks to ignore 3% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 10%.

Dirty Deeds.text: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 10, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

Preparation.text: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

Hemorrhage.text: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

Quietus.text: Your Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 2% more damage against targets below 35% health.

Cutthroat.text: Your Backstab has a 3% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth.

Thousand Cuts.text: When your Rupture ability deals periodic damage, the Energy cost of your next Hemorrhage or Backstab ability within 10 sec is reduced by 3, stacking up to 5 times.
